product_metadata.title: WPM Queen Blanket Sumptuously Soft Plush Coral Fleece Mega Throw/Reversible Bedspread (Brown)
features: Machine Wash Cold, Tumble Dry Low
description: Made from 100% microfiber Polyester, This Throw/Blanket is the Plush softest microfleece blanket. This blanket is not your usual mink blanket. it is the best quality, superior durability and extra warm blanket. Great winter Blanket. This luxurious throw can be used on a picnic, in the bedroom, or cuddle under it in the den while watching the TV. They are easy to care for, and are machine washable and dryable.
